title: CTV Advertising in 2026: Updated Market Forecast

facts.fact: eMarketer projects U.S. CTV ad spend to reach approximately $38 billion in 2026.
facts.quote: U.S. CTV advertising is projected to reach approximately $38 billion in 2026

facts.fact: The page states U.S. CTV ad spend grew from $33.35 billion in 2025 to an expected $38 billion in 2026, about 14% year-over-year growth.
facts.quote: The market grew from $33.35 billion in 2025 to an expected $38 billion in 2026

facts.fact: The page states CTV ad spend is projected to reach $46.89 billion by 2028 and surpass traditional TV advertising for the first time.
facts.quote: By 2028, CTV is projected to reach $46.89 billion and surpass traditional TV advertising for the first time in history.

facts.fact: eMarketer projects traditional TV ad spending to fall to approximately $45 billion in 2028, when CTV is expected to surpass it.
facts.quote: traditional TV advertising falls to approximately $45 billion

facts.fact: The page lists U.S. CTV ad spend of $28.6 billion for 2024 as actual.
facts.quote: 2024:** $28.6 billion (actual)

facts.fact: The page projects U.S. CTV ad spend of about $42 billion in 2027, with 11% projected growth.
facts.quote: 2027:** ~$42 billion (11% projected growth)

facts.fact: The page projects U.S. CTV ad spend of about $51 billion in 2029.
The page says total U.S. advertising grows at roughly 5-7% annually, which it compares to CTV growth.
facts.quote: total U.S. advertising grows at roughly 5-7% annually

facts.fact: The page reports that streaming captured a record 47.5% of all U.S. TV viewing in December 2025, according to Nielsen.
facts.quote: Streaming captured a record 47.5% of all U.S. TV viewing in December 2025

facts.fact: The page states Netflix's ad tier revenue exceeded $1.5 billion in 2025 and is expected to double in 2026, citing CNBC.
facts.quote: Netflix's ad tier revenue exceeded $1.5 billion in 2025

facts.fact: The page states Disney+ has 157 million ad-supported viewers.
facts.quote: Disney+ continues expanding its 157 million ad-supported viewers

facts.fact: The page states Netflix has 94 million ad-tier users.

facts.quote: Retail media CTV ad sales are expected to grow from $4.99 billion in 2025 to $10.28 billion by 2028
